meaning.en: To fight stripped to the waist; to take part openly and recklessly, or to act in person without disguise.
meaning.zh: 光着膀子上战场；比喻不加掩饰地亲自出面，或毫无顾忌地行事。

examples.zh: 老板亲自赤膊上阵，带队谈判。
examples.en: The boss went in personally and led the negotiations.

examples.zh: 别让孩子赤膊上阵，得有人带着他。
examples.en: Don't send the child in unprepared; someone must guide him.

usage.en: Predicate; can be neutral or mildly critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，中性或略含贬义。

meaning.en: Coming in pairs or couples.
meaning.zh: 结成一对一对。

examples.zh: 公园里的情侣成双成对。
examples.en: Couples stroll in the park in twos.

examples.zh: 鸳鸯成双成对地游在水上。
examples.en: Mandarin ducks swim on the water in pairs.

meaning.en: To make money and become wealthy.
meaning.zh: 获得钱财，变得富有。

examples.zh: 他梦想靠做生意发财致富。
examples.en: He dreams of getting rich through business.

examples.zh: 勤劳也能发财致富。
examples.en: Hard work can make you rich too.

usage.en: Predicate; widely used in news and ads.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于新闻和宣传。

meaning.en: All kinds of people.
meaning.zh: 各种各样的人。

examples.zh: 集市上聚集着各色人等。
examples.en: All sorts of people gather at the market.

examples.zh: 车站里各色人等来来往往。
examples.en: All kinds of people come and go in the station.

meaning.en: A farewell wish for a safe journey.
meaning.zh: 祝愿旅途平安顺利。

examples.zh: 临行前，大家祝他一路平安。
examples.en: Before he left, everyone wished him a safe journey.

examples.zh: 祝你一路平安，到了给我电话。
examples.en: Safe travels; call me when you arrive.

meaning.en: There is a hidden meaning or much to be made of it.
meaning.zh: 指其中另有深意或可做的事情很多。

equivalents: there's more than meets the eye

examples.zh: 这件事背后大有文章。
examples.en: There is much more behind this affair.

examples.zh: 他的解释听起来大有文章。
examples.en: His explanation sounds as though it hides something.

usage.en: Predicate; 文章 means hidden implications.

meaning.en: To devote oneself fully until death.
meaning.zh: 一直努力到死为止，形容尽力奉献。

examples.zh: 他为教育事业鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已。
examples.en: He devoted himself to education until death.

examples.zh: 为国效力，死而后已。
examples.en: I will serve the country until my dying day.

story.en: Zengzi: 'Humaneness is the burden he bears... is it not heavy? It ends only with death—is that not far?' (仁以为己任……死而后已).
story.zh: 《论语》：“仁以为己任，不亦重乎？死而后已，不亦远乎？”

meaning.en: To have frequent contact and be on very close terms.
meaning.zh: 互相交往、来往很密切。

examples.zh: 他和几位官员过从甚密。
examples.en: He was on close terms with several officials.

examples.zh: 两家公司的高管过从甚密。
examples.en: The executives of the two firms are in close contact.

usage.en: Predicate; formal, sometimes hints at impropriety.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，有时暗含不当关系。

pinyin: huà gān gē wéi yù bó
literal: turn · shields and spears · into · jade and silk

meaning.en: To turn hostility into friendship and make peace.
meaning.zh: 把战争或冲突化解为和平友好。

examples.zh: 两家终于化干戈为玉帛，握手言和。
examples.en: The two families finally buried the hatchet and made peace.

examples.zh: 愿双方化干戈为玉帛。
examples.en: May both sides turn conflict into friendship.

meaning.en: To demand perfection from others and criticise every flaw.
meaning.zh: 对人或事要求十全十美，苛求别人。

examples.zh: 对孩子不要求全责备。
examples.en: Don't demand perfection from children.

examples.zh: 他对下属求全责备，没人敢出错。
examples.en: He demands perfection of his staff and nobody dares to err.

synonyms: 鸡蛋里挑骨头——百般挑剔
antonyms: 水至清则无鱼，人至察则无徒

meaning.en: To refuse to yield even a little.
meaning.zh: 一点儿也不让步。

examples.zh: 双方在谈判中寸步不让。
examples.en: The two sides did not give an inch in the negotiations.

examples.zh: 球队在防守上寸步不让。
examples.en: The team yielded not an inch in defence.

meaning.en: To try something small to sound out the situation first.
meaning.zh: 先试探一下情况，再决定行动。

examples.zh: 他先发了份草案，投石问路。
examples.en: He first circulated a draft to test the waters.

examples.zh: 这次降价只是投石问路。
examples.en: This price cut is just a trial balloon.

meaning.en: Firm foundations that bring flourishing growth.
meaning.zh: 树根扎得深，枝叶就茂盛，比喻基础牢固，事业兴旺。

examples.zh: 这家老字号根深叶茂，经营了两百年。
examples.en: This old brand is firmly rooted and has thrived for two hundred years.

examples.zh: 文化根深叶茂，才能传承久远。
examples.en: Only a culture with deep roots can last.

meaning.en: Utterly cruel, devoid of all humanity.
meaning.zh: 丧失人所应有的理性和感情，极其凶残。

examples.zh: 侵略者的暴行灭绝人性。
examples.en: The invaders' atrocities were utterly inhuman.

examples.zh: 这种灭绝人性的罪行必须严惩。
examples.en: Such barbaric crimes must be severely punished.

meaning.en: To withdraw gracefully once one's work is done.
meaning.zh: 功业完成之后，及时引退。

examples.zh: 他拿下冠军后功成身退。
examples.en: He retired gracefully after winning the title.

examples.zh: 老总功成身退，把公司交给了年轻人。
examples.en: The chief stepped down in glory and handed the company to younger people.

story.en: Laozi: 'When the work is done, withdraw; this is Heaven's way' (功遂身退，天之道).

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

usage.en: Predicate; often an ideal of detachment.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，含推崇淡泊之意。

natural: your name rings in my ears

meaning.en: Said on meeting someone very famous: I have heard much about you.
meaning.zh: 形容人的名声很大，常作客套话。

equivalents: I have heard a great deal about you

examples.zh: 您的大名，我早已如雷贯耳。
examples.en: Your name has long rung in my ears.

examples.zh: 这位教授在学界如雷贯耳。
examples.en: The professor is thunderously famous in academia.

usage.en: Polite remark on a first meeting.

meaning.en: To give up one's own interests for the sake of others.
meaning.zh: 牺牲自己的利益去帮助别人。

examples.zh: 他舍己为人，跳进河里救起了孩子。
examples.en: He selflessly jumped into the river to save the child.

examples.zh: 舍己为人的精神值得学习。
examples.en: The spirit of selflessness is worth learning.

antonyms: 宁教我负天下人，休教天下人负我

pinyin: wàn biàn bù lí qí zōng
literal: ten-thousand · changes · not · leave · its · root

meaning.en: However things change, the essence stays the same.
meaning.zh: 不管形式怎么变化，本质始终不变。

equivalents: the more things change, the more they stay the same

examples.zh: 题型再变，也万变不离其宗。
examples.en: However the question types change, they stay the same at heart.

examples.zh: 广告手法万变不离其宗：抓住人心。
examples.en: Advertising tricks vary but always come down to winning hearts.

usage.en: Predicate; often 万变不离其宗.

meaning.en: A poor and remote area.
meaning.zh: 偏远而荒僻的地方。

examples.zh: 他从穷乡僻壤考进了大学。
examples.en: He got into university from a remote, poor village.

examples.zh: 这条路修通后，穷乡僻壤也有了生机。
examples.en: Once the road opened, even the backwaters came alive.

meaning.en: The ability to see what will happen beforehand.
meaning.zh: 事先看清事物发展趋势的眼光。

examples.zh: 他当年买下那块地，真有先见之明。
examples.en: He bought that land back then; what foresight.

examples.zh: 幸亏你有先见之明，带了伞。
examples.en: Luckily you had the foresight to bring an umbrella.

story.en: Hou Han Shu, Yang Biao: 'I regret lacking the foresight of Jin Midi' (愧无日磾先见之明).
story.zh: 《后汉书》载杨彪语：“愧无日磾先见之明。”

meaning.en: To blame the person who has accused you.
meaning.zh: 自己有错，反而指责对方。

examples.zh: 他撞了人还倒打一耙，说是对方不看路。
examples.en: He hit someone and then turned on them, saying they hadn't watched the road.

examples.zh: 别对批评你的人倒打一耙。
examples.en: Don't hit back at those who criticise you.

usage.en: Predicate; from the Pigsy episode in Journey to the West.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，传说出自《西游记》猪八戒。

synonyms: 小偷击鼓进大堂——恶人先告状

meaning.en: To chat about all sorts of topics.
meaning.zh: 漫无边际地闲谈，什么都谈。

equivalents: chat about everything under the sun

examples.zh: 周末几个朋友聚在一起谈天说地。
examples.en: On weekends friends gather to chat about everything.

examples.zh: 他俩在茶馆里谈天说地一下午。
examples.en: They spent the afternoon in a teahouse chatting about everything.

meaning.en: To stir up trouble when there is none.
meaning.zh: 本来没事，故意制造纠纷。

examples.zh: 他整天无事生非，同事都躲着他。
examples.en: He makes trouble out of nothing all day, so colleagues avoid him.

examples.zh: 你别无事生非，大家好好相处。
examples.en: Don't invent trouble; let's all get along.

synonyms: 张飞妈妈姓吴——无事（吴氏）生非（飞）

natural: strive to be in the lead

meaning.en: To strive to be at the forefront.
meaning.zh: 努力争取达到先进水平。

examples.zh: 我们要力争上游，不甘落后。
examples.en: We must strive to lead and not fall behind.

examples.zh: 他在学习上一直力争上游。
examples.en: He has always striven to be among the best in his studies.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 不甘落后.
